summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py: thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__, set at the start of run_async and cleared in a finally (via new helper _run_async_body). The method checks not-running, then same-thread, schedules via run_coroutine_threadsafe a task that calls self._set_active() then invoke(partial(...)), and blocks in 50 ms slices so a shutdown mid-call raises "App is not running" instead of hanging. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 9 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH=<repo>/src (the venv's textual points at tasks/.../base). Full suite excluding snapshot, devtools and cli: 614 passed, 68 failed; the failures I inspected come from the environment (pytest-asyncio not installed for async tests/fixtures, aiohttp missing for devtools), not confirmed against a baseline. Nothing committed.
